analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단(10/27) 이후 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 33.0→42.1 상승으로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 -6.7684→-3.6496 개선으로 바닥 다지기 신호 강화. 5일 저가 $80.22 대비 20일 저가 $80.22로 Higher Low 패턴 회복 초입 구간 진입. 주봉 RSI 44.9, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -8.3435로 여전히 약세 구간이나, 일봉상 단기 반등 신호 포착. ADX 27.1로 추세는 뚜렷하나 +DI 21.5, -DI 36.3으로 하락 압력이 우위. 그러나 RSI와 MACD 개선이 뚜렷하여 매수 진입 고려.
analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy decision (10/27), a wait-and-see stance was maintained for 3 consecutive sessions. Today, RSI confirmed an exit from oversold territory with a rise from 33.0 to 42.1. The MACD histogram improved from -6.7684 to -3.6496, strengthening the bottoming signal. A Higher Low pattern is entering its initial recovery phase, with the 5-day low at $80.22 and the 20-day low at $80.22. Weekly RSI is 44.9 and weekly MACD histogram is -8.3435, indicating a bearish zone. However, daily signals show a short-term rebound. ADX is 27.1, indicating a clear trend, but downside pressure is dominant with +DI at 21.5 and -DI at 36.3. Nevertheless, the clear improvement in RSI and MACD warrants consideration for a buy entry.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly is bearish, but daily signals take precedence
